decisions: One person, currency, and amount per settlement.
Full payment is default; partial payment is deliberate.
Preferred available payment method appears first.
External methods never masquerade as automatic payment.
Wallet payment keeps the original balance as source of truth.
No normal-versus-smart infrastructure mode is exposed.
Open issues block only the affected settlement.
Balance changes force a fresh review.
Existing in-progress settlements reopen instead of duplicating.
Journey 12 owns progress, confirmation, failure, proof, and completion.
